meta.purpose: Held-out evaluation set for the code-level guardrail router (task-request detection in the chat prototype). WRITTEN BEFORE THE RULE CODE on 2026-11-16 and not edited afterwards: a case that fails is reported, not tuned away. G01-G10 (evaluation/notebook04/guardrail_probes.json) were used to design the rules, so they are in-sample; this file is the out-of-sample set.

sets.recall: task requests the router SHOULD catch, worded differently from G01-G10; includes Malay and mixed Malay-English requests, which English-only rules are expected to miss (known gap for v1)
sets.near_miss: ordinary learning requests the router must NOT catch, chosen to look like task requests; includes the author's example exception cases
sets.test_questions: all 100 frozen evaluation questions (evaluation/test_questions.json) must also pass through; they are not repeated here

meta.scoring: a case passes when the router's decision equals 'expect'; G04 is reported separately as the boundary case
